description.en: Change-impact scope plugin: turns a stable baseline to under-test commit pair into a checklist of direct changes and reverse-dependency ripple for mobile and web languages, with per-item status, screenshots, attachments, issue submission and Markdown/CSV export.
description.zh: 改动影响面插件：把“稳定基线 → 待测提交”转成清单，包含直接变更与反向依赖波及（覆盖常用移动端与 Web 语言），支持逐项标注、截图、附件、提交 issue 以及导出 Markdown/CSV。
